proposedCacheContract.appearance: Preserve current JSON key normalization(s1/walk0), exact drawPerson/leg builder and every position/color/shape attribute. Prefix through the appearance builder is byte-identical to the reference implementation.
proposedCacheContract.leases: Each caller receives shared body/leg plus idempotent release. Live references cannot be evicted or disposed.
proposedCacheContract.idleBudget: After final borrower release, an entry becomes idle. Least recently used idle entries are disposed until both<=128idle appearances and<=16MiB estimated array CPU+GPU bytes hold. Active appearances are additional and bounded by existing live-owner counts.
proposedCacheContract.finalRelease: Final release makes an appearance eligible for eviction; it may remain in the explicitly bounded idle reuse cache. Forced trim releases all idle entries, never live geometry.
proposedCacheContract.instrumentation: Exported created/disposed/refcount/estimated-byte counters support deterministic ownership tests. Estimated bytes are not measured GPU VRAM. No QA/HUD/rendering instrumentation is added by this patch.

risksAndLimits: No tests, typechecks, builds, runtime mutation or performance measurements have been executed for this proposal during the frozen baseline soak. Root must review/apply and validate after baseline completion.

Removed-event hooks treat current walker/exchange groups as one-use figures. Static search found no reparent/re-add path. A future live reparent/reuse must retain/reacquire a lease rather than reuse a released group.
All three current production walkerGeometry callers are covered. Any future caller must release its lease; do not dispose shared body/leg buffers directly.

The idle cache adds bounded bookkeeping/filter-sort work at spawn/despawn, not every render frame. Actual frame impact still requires the subsequent frozen comparison; no timing or people-count change is proposed.

Station figures intentionally stay leased for the finite station-life owner's lifetime. A full engine/application teardown is outside this patch; page/context destruction ends remaining program-lifetime resources.
Blindly disposing all cache entries at old cache.clear() would invalidate live walkers, metro transfers and bus people. This proposal avoids that ownership error.

A separate inherited temporary-sky leak was independently found at engine.ts109-113/sky.ts45: makeSky geometry/material are not disposed after PMREM capture. It is outside this pedestrian patch, is already reported to Root, and may leave residual growth even when pedestrian retirement is fixed.
